plugins.description: browse and manage DeV's skills, plugins and MCP servers
plugins.template:
Use the catalog tool to manage DeV's skills, plugins and MCP servers. Request: $ARGUMENTS

If the request is empty, list the catalog (action list), grouped by kind with each entry's user/project status in one short line each, then ask what to install, enable or disable. Otherwise carry the request out with the catalog tool and report the result.
